guard/32137.htm.text: Marksman Sucrete Like sunlight bursting through a bank of clouds, I hope that great power is within you... This is the Grotto of the Soul, the origin of all Kamael, where our history began. When you fully realize what this means, you will better understand our role in the destiny of the world.
